intent: Cluster test for successive leader failures on a 5-node cluster: kills the leader twice with enough writes between failures that returning nodes must pass through SYNCHRONIZING before re-leading or following, and verifies that sequence is actually observed.

objects.name: MultipleLeaderSyncTest::runTrivialWrites
objects.role: issues a batch of trivial UPDATE/INSERT writes to advance a node's commit count

objects.name: MultipleLeaderSyncTest::waitForCommit
objects.role: polls a node's Status until its commitCount reaches a minimum, or times out

objects.name: MultipleLeaderSyncTest::test
objects.role: builds the cluster, fails leader twice while writing between failures, restarts both downed nodes concurrently, and watches each pass through the expected state sequence
